title: Aurum Alpha vulnerability disclosure policy
description: The content SECURITY.md must state (SB7 of standards/085-security-baseline.md), in the structured form a checker extracts from the markdown section by section, plus the fields the served /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116) must carry. The markdown is what a finder reads; this shape is what a checker proves is present. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this shape; additive evolution per PC6.

reporting.description: The Reporting section (SB7): where a finder sends a report and how.

channels.description: At least one monitored channel (SB7). A repository handed over replaces these with the new owner's at handover.

kind.description: The kind of channel: a mailbox, a web form, or a hosting platform's private advisory mechanism (SB7).

location.description: The address or URL of the channel, as a URI (a mailto: URI for a mailbox) (SB7).

encryption.description: Where a finder obtains a key to encrypt a report, as a URI; RFC 9116's Encryption field carries the same value (SB7).

report_should_include.description: What the policy asks a report to contain: affected component, reproduction steps, impact (SB7).

response.description: The Response section (SB7): two numbers. A commitment without a number is not a commitment.

acknowledge_within_business_days.description: Business days within which the finder is told the report was received. Three is the ceiling (SB7).

triage_within_days.description: Calendar days within which the finder is told whether the report is accepted and at what severity. Fourteen is the ceiling (SB7).

scope.description: The Scope section (SB7): what the policy covers and what it does not.

in_scope.description: The systems, origins and repositories the policy covers (SB7).

out_of_scope.description: What is excluded: third-party services, denial of service, social engineering, and anything else the policy names (SB7).

safe_harbour.description: The Safe harbour section (SB7): that good-faith research within scope will not be pursued, stated in plain words. A finder who fears the report will not send it.

stated.description: True when the section states the commitment; the schema admits no other value because a policy without it is not accepted (SB7).

disclosure.description: The Disclosure section (SB7): whether and when the finder may publish, and whether they are credited.

coordinated.description: Whether publication is coordinated with the fix (SB7).

finder_may_publish_after_days.description: The day count after which the finder may publish regardless, where the policy states one (SB7).

credit_offered.description: Whether the finder is credited if they wish to be (SB7).

security_txt.description: The fields the served /.well-known/security.txt carries, per RFC 9116 (SB7).

contact.description: RFC 9116 Contact: at least one URI, in order of preference (SB7).

expires.description: RFC 9116 Expires, as an IP4 instant: no more than a year out and renewed before it passes, because an expired file tells a finder the policy may be abandoned (SB7). The one-year bound is judged against the calendar by the checker.

policy.description: RFC 9116 Policy: the URL where SECURITY.md is published (SB7).

canonical.description: RFC 9116 Canonical: where the file's home is, when this origin is not it (SB7).

encryption.description: RFC 9116 Encryption: where a finder obtains a key (SB7).
